title: Adopt audited Phase 1 execution sequence
context: v0.1 domain content was broad but its sequential freeze plan lacked scope termination and separated interlocking commercial concerns.
decision: Adopt Phase 1 Roadmap v1.0: control → beachhead/scope → primary workflows → competitors → boundary/ownership → concurrent commercial core → evidence → integration → reporting → UI → NFR/AI readiness → golden-thread validation.
alternatives: Keep v0.1 sequence; partially reorder only; build modules incrementally before full architecture.
reasons: Reduces ontology anchoring, fake freezes, unbounded scope and late financial seam discovery.
consequences: v0.1 process sequence is superseded; v0.1 domain content remains provisional input.

title: Treat cost ledger as commercial event substrate, not presumed full GL
context: Audit correctly identified missing substrate beneath derived balances; external accounting may remain authoritative.
decision: Phase 1 must design one canonical commercial cost-event/posting model sufficient to derive product balances, while whether the product owns a double-entry GL remains open for P1.4/P1.5.
alternatives: No internal ledger; full accounting GL from day one.
reasons: Ensures reconciliation without prematurely expanding into full accounting ERP.
consequences: P1.5b is mandatory; accounting ownership remains an explicit boundary decision.

title: Procurement structural root
context: ASM-0001: package-led procurement may not represent ordinary material/requisition/call-off procurement.
decision: Adopt a polycentric procurement graph: authorized requirement source → RequirementAllocation lineage → optional ProcurementPackage → sourcing route → AwardDecision → external handoff or effective Commitment. No universal Package, DemandLine, Allocation or ProcurementCase root owns end-to-end truth.
alternatives: ProcurementPackage universal root; requisition/item-led root; equal first-class paths; higher-order sourcing/commitment abstraction.
reasons: Preserves ordinary demand-led, package-led and direct-source routes without creating a hidden universal root or duplicate truth owner.
consequences: Navigation/reporting may project across canonical identities; physical entity/cardinality implementation must preserve the polycentric ownership model.

title: PO and Subcontract type model
context: ASM-0002: hard-separating PO and Subcontract may duplicate state, changes and financial logic.
decision: Adopt one semantic Commitment core for effective supplier obligations, with bounded kind/profile differences for PO, subcontract, call-off/release and supported service forms. Keep ScopeBasis, ValuationBasis and CapabilityProfile as distinct axes; use one P07 CommercialEffectVector algebra with COMPONENT or OBLIGATION subject grain and no separate mini-ledgers by document type.
alternatives: Separate entities; common Commitment supertype; composition around shared commercial interfaces.
reasons: Preserves legally and operationally different fulfilment/valuation behaviour while keeping obligation, change, correction, conservation and derived positions coherent.
consequences: Current closed capability/valuation mappings and minimum-obligation semantics are frozen; future new contractual mechanisms require prospective controlled extension rather than overloading existing effects/profiles.

title: Accounting and commercial ownership seam
context: ASM-0003/Q-0002: product and accounting platform may split ownership of certification, invoice, retention, payment and ledger truth.
decision: Adopt split fact/event-level authority: the OS owns procurement/commercial truth required by activated domains, including P07 commitment/change/valuation truth when active; external ERP/accounting remains authoritative for AP posting/liability, payment/cash, GL/accounting close and job-cost/accounting postings where configured. Certification and accounting posting are distinct, and ERP representation is never a co-master of product commercial truth.
alternatives: Product owns all financial truth; accounting owns everything; entity-level ownership; split field/event authority.
reasons: Prevents dual masters while allowing strong commercial control without expanding into full GL/AP/cash ERP.
consequences: P1.5 must implement fact/event-level authority, history-preserving correction and reconciliation under this seam; connector depth is governed by accepted ADR-0006 and physical posting/reversal remains ADR-0015.

title: V1 ERP/accounting integration depth
context: Deep integration may be strategically important but can dominate V1 implementation burden and create a connector co-master or launch dependency.
decision: Adopt tiered V1 depth: mandatory native/manual A0–A3 fallback; mandatory bounded structured-file exchange; mandatory internal operation/event/connector/email readiness substrate with optional external activation; evidence-driven selected named connectors; deep real-time integration later by default. A provider-neutral email port is mandatory and release planning must select at least one V1_EMAIL_CORE_CONFORMING adapter, but no named connector is required before first live tender.
alternatives: Deep real-time connector as SPINE; thin import/export only; interface contracts with no implementation substrate; one mandatory ERP connector; no V1 integration.
reasons: Gives builders a concrete V1 floor and future expansion path without allowing ERP/CDE/email integration to dominate the beachhead or become business authority.
consequences: Public API gateway, broker/webhooks, named ERP/CDE/bank connectors, chat/agent runtime, broad historical migration and deep integration remain optional activations. Authority/event/evidence/migration meanings remain invariant across tiers.

title: Long-lead tracking object model
context: ASM-0005/Q-0008: long-lead milestones may belong to package, commitment line, submittal, shipment or independent tracked object.
decision: Reject a universal independent TrackedItem root. Use thin ProcurementMilestoneInstance-style planning/observation identities anchored to existing requirement/allocation/package/tender/award/Commitment/component/technical/external-shipment lineage as applicable; actual status derives from canonical domain or authoritative external events.
alternatives: Independent TrackedItem; milestone instances on existing objects; composition across linked objects.
reasons: Preserves cross-workflow traceability while avoiding duplicate transaction truth and CPM/master-schedule gravity.
consequences: P10 remains a procurement/expediting overlay; planned, forecast, confirmed and actual milestone facts remain distinct.

title: Workflow engine generality in V1
context: ASM-0006: a fully general workflow engine may be powerful but can create major configuration/testing burden.
decision: Adopt bounded shared control primitives for approvals, DOA/threshold routing, delegation, sequential/parallel review, bounded conditions, returns/information requests, expiry/escalation, compliance/technical prerequisites and supported overrides. Workflow outcomes are inputs to deterministic domain commands and never direct writers of commercial truth.
alternatives: Fully general engine; constrained shared approval engine; module-specific fixed workflows.
reasons: Provides reusable control without creating a programmable BPM gravity well or bypass path into P07 truth.
consequences: Tenant configuration cannot author arbitrary state machines, mutation rules or financial effects; broader interaction/orchestration remains later UI/AI work.

title: Configuration breadth in V1
context: ASM-0007/Q-0007: broad custom fields/configuration multiply onboarding, testing and migration complexity.
decision: Adopt constrained typed, versioned and auditable configuration over product-supported policy/profile dimensions. No arbitrary financial formula scripts, custom event types, custom state machines, custom capability graphs or generic mutation rules in V1.
alternatives: Broad no-code configuration; constrained configuration; fixed product standards with limited overrides.
reasons: Preserves controlled adaptability and historical reproducibility without turning V1 into a low-code platform.
consequences: Load-bearing configuration binds to governed cases/events under ADR-0020; future new semantic members require controlled architecture change before activation.

title: GCC commercial semantics versus late localization
context: ASM-0008: retention, VAT/tax timing, guarantees, certification and FIDIC-derived practices may shape core semantics rather than presentation.
decision: PENDING — P1.5 freezes a common Commercial Core with deterministic regional/contract policy seams and keeps certification, statutory tax, retention, advance, security and final-account meanings distinct. Exact UAE/GCC rates, statutory timing, legal defaults and localization obligations remain evidence-driven later work.
alternatives: Late localization; GCC-native core semantics; generic core with regional policy modules.
reasons: A late decision can force ledger/state migration.
consequences: NON-BLOCKING after P1.5: later regional evidence may populate/refine bounded policy but may not fork the Commercial Core or silently redefine frozen event/effect meanings.

title: Budget and cost attribution timing
context: ASM-0009: requiring budget/cost-code structure before procurement may block valid ad-hoc or early sourcing.
decision: PENDING — P1.5 freezes that sourcing may precede final detailed coding where policy permits, but an effective Commitment must bind explicit product commercial attribution, either final mapping or governed visible suspense/unallocated identity with downstream resolution gates. Detailed suspense/attribution operating mechanics remain later refinement.
alternatives: Mandatory before requisition; mandatory before award/commitment; controlled late allocation.
reasons: Changes entity guards and reporting semantics.
consequences: NON-BLOCKING after P1.5: later detail cannot permit null/hidden attribution or unresolved suspense beyond transitions that require final mapping.

title: External vendor identity and access model
context: ASM-0010/Q-0006: supplier access friction, confidentiality and cross-tenant identity pull in different directions.
decision: Adopt tenant-private supplier/subcontractor business relationships with optional reusable technical authentication identity. Internal authorization and external grants are separate semantic models; an external grant can never satisfy internal role/delegation/DOA/domain authority. Guest/email/account/buyer-on-behalf paths may coexist, persistent signup is optional, and account reuse exposes no cross-tenant relationship directory or imported history/grants.
alternatives: Tenant-scoped accounts; cross-tenant supplier network identity; magic-link/guest only; hybrid.
reasons: Preserves low-friction participation and future reusable identity without creating cross-tenant business leakage or a mandatory supplier network.
consequences: Authentication vendor/protocol and persistent-identity storage remain later implementation choices; P1.5 must preserve tenant-private relationship boundaries.

title: Event-derived procurement status versus manual trackers
context: ASM-0011: status duplication creates drift but some planning data may legitimately remain human-maintained.
decision: Adopt hybrid typed status semantics: REQUIRED/PLANNED/FORECAST/CONFIRMED remain explicit versioned planning/observation facts, while ACTUAL transactional milestone/status derives from canonical domain events or an authoritative external actual source where configured. No manual second actual-status truth.
alternatives: Fully event-derived; hybrid derived/planned; manual tracker parity.
reasons: Preserves legitimate planning/forecast work while preventing duplicate manual actual-state trackers and drift.
consequences: P10 remains a thin expediting overlay; planned, forecast, confirmed and actual milestone facts remain distinct.

title: Document provenance ownership and depth
context: ASM-0012: disputes and future AI require source/version/location provenance, but an external CDE may own part of it.
decision: Adopt a bounded first-class evidence substrate: the OS owns integrity/provenance of product-governed transaction evidence and exact supplier-facing release versions; externally authoritative CDE/ERP/bank/legal/master records remain REFERENCE or narrow MIRROR. Load-bearing evidence is history-preserving while retained, payload disposition does not reverse domain history, and eligible disposition preserves only the minimum justified evidence/disposition record required for reconstruction.
alternatives: Product owns full document/CDE model; external CDE owns everything; immutable evidence references with bounded local custody/provenance.
reasons: Retrofit cannot recreate missing transaction provenance, while full CDE/records-management ownership would create a second gravity well.
consequences: Physical storage/hash/redaction depth and jurisdictional retention rules remain later design/legal work. Reconstruction is for legitimately entitled tenant governance/audit users, supported correction/dispute actors, and external reviewers/regulators only where contract/law/product scope requires it.

title: Posting finalization reversal and correction semantics
context: ASM-0013/Q-0003: mutable CRUD financial records cannot safely support certification, period close and corrections.
decision: Adopt immutable typed CommercialEffectVector semantics with history-preserving correction modes: non-economic amendment, reverse-and-replace, forward adjustment, physical/source reversal, reclassification and integration-only correction. True reversal negates original effects under original semantics; replacement/forward adjustment creates new effects; reclassification is zero-net commercial value; no economic in-place rewrite.
alternatives: Mutable versioned records; append-only events with reversals; full accounting journal semantics.
reasons: Provides one reproducible correction algebra across commitment, certification, retention, advance, allowance and recovery without expanding into GL journal accounting.
consequences: Closed-period and integration policies determine permitted effective period/mode but never justify silent history rewrite or truth mutation to make synchronization pass.

title: External-party UX priority
context: ASM-0014: vendor/subcontractor UX can determine participation quality but may not require parity with internal UX.
decision: PENDING — define external UX obligations after supplier-side primary evidence.
alternatives: Full portal parity; task-focused external UX; email-first/guest workflows; hybrid.
reasons: Changes identity communications and interaction architecture.
consequences: Do not build elaborate portal surface before the participation model is proven.

title: AI-readiness deterministic substrate
context: ASM-0015: future AI may dominate the interface, but only some constraints are costly to retrofit.
decision: PENDING — decide broader AI-readiness scope later; two irreversible substrate constraints are separately accepted by ADR-0024.
alternatives: No early AI constraints; bounded actions + provenance only; broader agent-native model from inception.
reasons: Controls whether future AI is a UI replacement or an architectural rewrite.
consequences: Broader AI-readiness remains open even though two pre-model constraints and the tenant-data isolation boundary are binding.

title: Workflow-to-financial-state seam
context: A configurable workflow must not be able to bypass domain financial guards.
decision: Workflow/task/approval state may authorize or produce an outcome consumed by a bounded deterministic domain transition, but workflow/evidence/integration state can never itself become commitment, payment, balance or other commercial/accounting truth.
alternatives: Workflow directly sets business/financial state; workflow emits outcome consumed by domain action; fixed domain approvals only.
reasons: Prevents configurable workflow or future agents from bypassing commercial invariants.
consequences: P1.5 workflow design must route state change through validated domain actions; workflow breadth remains ADR-0008.

title: Effective dating and temporal authority semantics
context: Authority, delegation, FX, cost structures and org/legal structures change while historical transactions must remain interpretable.
decision: Adopt hybrid temporal semantics for load-bearing history: preserve immutable record/event identity and recorded/audit time, business-effective time/period where material, governing policy/config/master/authority versions, and correction/supersession lineage. External facts preserve source effective/version context where available plus observed/fetched/freshness state. Historical interpretation uses bound governing versions rather than current lookup.
alternatives: Current-value lookup only; snapshot at transaction time; effective-dated/bitemporal resolution.
reasons: Makes approvals, rates, authority and corrections historically reproducible without forcing universal bitemporal tables or full configuration snapshots.
consequences: Physical temporal storage remains implementation choice; controlled backdating/migration must preserve both effective meaning and required known-at/reconstruction context.

title: Configuration binding for in-flight instances
context: Configuration can change while approvals and commercial workflows are already in progress.
decision: Bind load-bearing policy/configuration versions to the governed case/event. Historical interpretation uses the governing version, while current membership/delegation/security capability is checked for every new action. Silent rebinding is forbidden; legitimate change requires explicit governed migration or re-evaluation.
alternatives: Live resolution; full snapshot at instantiation; explicit load-bearing version binding with controlled migration.
reasons: Separates historical reproducibility from live security and avoids both current-config history rewriting and indiscriminate full-config snapshots.
consequences: Physical temporal/configuration storage remains ADR-0019/P1.5; P1.5 may catalogue load-bearing facts only by applying the frozen P1.4 test.

title: Field-level integration authority and staleness
context: One entity may contain fields authoritative in different systems and users may act on stale synchronized values.
decision: Adopt load-bearing fact/field/event-level OWN/MIRROR/REFERENCE/OUT authority with one authoritative source/writer per effective period. External load-bearing values expose source/freshness/conflict state; connector/middleware is never business authority; authority transfer uses governed cutover and synchronization rejection is classified before correction.
alternatives: Entity-level ownership only; field-level authority matrix; event ownership by domain.
reasons: Entity-level ownership is insufficient for mixed ERP/product records and encourages hidden dual masters.
consequences: Deployment authority matrices freshness thresholds and connector mechanisms remain later design; accepted P1.7 ADR-0031 supplies the semantic connector/cutover contract.

title: Money representation rounding and calculation order
context: Progress claims, retention, tax, recoupment and adjustments compound rounding decisions into legally significant values.
decision: Adopt exact-decimal authoritative money with explicit currency and versioned MonetaryCalculationPolicy defining precision, rounding mode/boundaries, ordered supported stages, FX/tax purpose hooks, rounding-difference treatment and correction rule. Distinct load-bearing FX purposes bind source/rate/fixing date/version; commercial certificate tax remains distinct from statutory tax authority.
alternatives: Per-module rounding; global monetary policy; external-accounting-calculated values only.
reasons: Prevents modules from deriving different legally significant values from the same commercial basis while preserving distinct contractual, reporting, minimum-qualification, tax and accounting currency purposes.
consequences: Exact decimal/storage library and physical calculation implementation remain later design; tenant-authored arbitrary formula scripts are not part of V1.

title: Numbering under concurrency retries and fiscal rules
context: Document/PO/contract numbering can conflict with retries, rollback and per-entity/fiscal sequencing requirements.
decision: Separate immutable internal identity from human/legal display numbering. Use versioned bounded numbering policy for scope, format, sequence, gap rule, allocation milestone, fiscal-date rule and cancellation/reuse semantics; high-risk issuance/actions require stable idempotency identity, expected state/version or causal precondition, atomic invariants and deterministic retry.
alternatives: Database sequence; reserve-on-commit sequence service; non-gapless UUID plus display number; jurisdiction-specific policy.
reasons: Prevents numbering requirements from undermining idempotency/concurrency correctness while allowing entity/fiscal/legal display rules to vary under governed policy.
consequences: No universal gapless promise is made absent evidence/law/contract; physical sequence/lock technology remains implementation choice.

title: Adopt two irreversible pre-model substrate constraints
context: Phase 1 needs only AI-readiness constraints that are cheap now but expensive or impossible to retrofit after commercial history exists.
decision: Adopt two binding constraints from inception: commercially significant truth must support source/version/location provenance; every state-changing business operation must be a bounded validated service/domain action rather than arbitrary mutation. Broader AI-readiness remains open under ADR-0017.
alternatives: No early AI-readiness constraints; adopt a broader agent-native architecture immediately.
reasons: Missing provenance cannot be recreated reliably later, and an unsafe mutation surface would require rebuilding before future agents could act safely.
consequences: REQ-0001 and REQ-0002 become accepted cross-cutting constraints; this does not assume any AI capability will succeed.

title: Data residency region declaration and governed migration
context: P1.4 requires a customer-contractual residency boundary without prematurely selecting backup DR telemetry or physical replication topology.
decision: Adopt a tenant-level declared primary residency region for product-hosted tenant/business/evidence data categories included in the product residency commitment. Legal entities/projects do not independently choose arbitrary regions by default. Later NFR architecture must explicitly classify backup/DR/telemetry/service-metadata paths against the commitment, and region change requires governed effective-dated migration with in-flight treatment and replica/copy disposition. No UAE/GCC localization requirement is asserted by this ADR.
alternatives: No residency concept until deployment; per-project arbitrary regions; universal physical region-lock for all infrastructure data.
reasons: Makes residency contractual semantics explicit while preserving physical NFR design freedom and preventing hidden exception paths.
consequences: Jurisdiction-specific localization/retention obligations and the concrete residency category catalogue remain evidence-driven legal/NFR work.

title: Cross-tenant data isolation and shared-learning boundary
context: Direct tenant isolation is insufficient when AI embeddings retrieval agent memory adaptive learning benchmarks or sub-processors can create cross-tenant influence without directly disclosing source records.
decision: Default V1 isolation covers both direct disclosure and indirect effect: tenant business data must not create improve or influence another tenant's business outputs recommendations mappings rankings benchmarks supplier scores embeddings retrieval corpus agent memory or adaptive/fine-tuned behavior. Shared model/agent executable infrastructure is allowed with tenant-scoped authorized context; shared learned tenant business knowledge is OUT by default across all processing paths including third-party models/sub-processors. Future cross-tenant shared learning/benchmarking requires an explicit separately governed participation mode with purpose/data/de-identification/provenance/re-identification/withdrawal rules and cannot be required by A0–A3.
alternatives: Allow any de-identified aggregate use by default; prohibit all shared model infrastructure; permit cross-tenant learning under generic service consent.
reasons: Preserves future single-agent/multi-agent/model-replacement architecture while preventing an accidental supplier/data network and an irreversible privacy/authority retrofit.
consequences: Per-invocation isolation memory/retrieval partitioning and future shared-learning mechanics remain later AI/NFR design. Participation terms must state realistic withdrawal effects and must not promise technically impossible retroactive unlearning.

title: Evidence identity version content-integrity and reconstruction-anchor model
context: P1.6 must preserve exact historical evidence provenance without making filename hash URL current pointer or content storage into business identity or authority.
decision: Adopt distinct EvidenceRecord EvidenceVersion ContentIdentity/IntegrityAssertion SourcePrincipal/attribution CaptureObservation/CommunicationOccurrence SourceLocator EvidenceBinding and immutable RelianceBinding semantics. Effective historical reliance binds exact source version/location and cannot silently rebind. A load-bearing external source must pass the mandatory ReconstructionAnchorTest core or use permitted immutable local capture under an explicit materialization policy. Hash/content identity never substitutes for business evidence identity authenticity authority or truth.
alternatives: Full product CDE/document ownership; external reference only with no local provenance; hash/content-addressed identity as business identity; mutable current-link references.
reasons: Provides dispute-grade source/version/location reconstruction and future AI provenance without creating a second CDE/records-management gravity well.
consequences: P1.7 connectors must prove historical version semantics and preserve authority/freshness/conflict state. Physical storage hash provider indexing and UI remain later design.

title: Communication transmittal delivery acknowledgment and domain-effect boundary
context: P1.6 must support communication-gated business effectiveness without letting documents messages callbacks or corrected evidence become a second business-truth writer.
decision: Adopt channel-neutral Transmittal and exact MessageEnvelope/CommunicationOccurrence evidence while keeping issue dispatch delivery/receipt read/open receipt acknowledgment substantive response and owning-domain effectiveness distinct. Pattern B binds immutable addressee/channel/prerequisite/time/calendar/completion semantics before issue. OBSERVATION_COMPLETES_EFFECT freezes a CommunicationSatisfactionSnapshot and establishes one owning-domain event once; later evidence correction retraction or late discovery cannot automatically reverse or retime it and any consequence change requires bounded owning-domain correction.
alternatives: Communication directly writes business state; delivery/acknowledgment collapsed; implementation-selected recipient/channel defaults; live projection of effectiveness over current evidence; fully separate per-channel business lifecycles.
reasons: Closes evidence-to-domain authority and crash/retry/retraction ambiguity while supporting contractual service/effectiveness rules without a new workflow/email subsystem.
consequences: P1.7 implements idempotent snapshot-to-domain establishment and explicit pending/variance/error states without moving business authority into middleware. Physical transaction/outbox/event technology remains later design.

title: Capability-neutral bounded interface substrate
context: UI services imports connectors email chat and future agents need one operation meaning without assuming AI reliability or exposing arbitrary mutation.
decision: Adopt one versioned OperationRegistry and common invocation/result contract with exactly QUERY PROPOSAL COMMAND and ASYNC_OPERATION classes. Proposals never become authoritative without a bounded command. Capabilities have governed enable/disable/deprecate/retire lifecycle and manual deterministic fallback. All initiators including future agents use the same authorization-filtered operations and receive no raw database/event-store write path.
alternatives: Separate UI/API/connector/agent actions; generic CRUD service; agent-specific privileged tools; AI-first interface substrate.
reasons: Prevents parallel meanings and unsafe mutation while allowing optional capabilities to expand reduce or be replaced as evidence develops.
consequences: P1.9 may design conventional/chat UX and P1.10 may design agent reasoning/autonomy without changing domain authority. Product implementation must include the mandatory internal substrate accepted by ADR-0006.

title: Domain integration event and immutable publication-recovery boundary
context: At-least-once lossy asynchronous transport and later schema/disclosure/target changes can create duplicate effects or change retry meaning.
decision: Keep DomainEvent IntegrationEvent TransportEnvelope and ExternalObservation distinct. Bind every outbound publication to immutable PublicationIntent with source fact/version mapping/schema/disclosure and complete representation-generation versions plus exact target or frozen distribution/recipient basis. Retry uses the original intent; target/audience or semantic changes create a new publication and when effect-bearing a new logical operation. Domain commit remains authoritative when publication fails; gaps duplicates reordering and replay use stable identities resynchronization and history-preserving correction.
alternatives: Treat webhook as domain event; generate payload using current mapping on retry; mutable destination/subscriber routing; exactly-once transport assumption.
reasons: Preserves historical publication meaning and prevents transport behavior from becoming business authority or duplicate product effect.
consequences: Physical outbox broker event-store serializer and gateway technology remains open but must preserve immutable publication intent and recovery semantics.

title: Connector execution authority effect uncertainty and conformance
context: Clean success/failure models are insufficient for service-account delegation connector cutover and external calls that may have produced an effect despite timeout.
decision: Adopt five closed ExecutionAuthorityModes with delegated permission as intersection and no implicit impersonation; ConnectorProfile/AuthorityMapping at load-bearing fact/action grain under OWN/MIRROR/REFERENCE/OUT; and a closed seven-stage effect taxonomy PRE_ACCEPTANCE ACCEPTED_PRE_EFFECT EFFECT_INDETERMINATE EXTERNAL_EFFECT_EMITTED DOMAIN_EFFECT_ESTABLISHED TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT PARTIAL_EFFECT. Pre-effect/no-effect after an effect-bearing attempt requires positive proof. While indeterminate ordinary retry rebind cancellation effect-bearing continuation and conflicting replacement are prohibited; only reconciliation manual or blocked dispositions are allowed. Permanently unresolvable positions may close operationally only as explicit unresolved variance without asserting no effect. Connector conformance changes future eligibility/current confidence but never silently rewrites historical bindings.
alternatives: Broad service-account authority; connector as co-master; timeout treated as failure; retry under new adapter; generic pending/failed status; current conformance invalidates history.
reasons: Prevents authority escalation duplicate external effects and unsafe cutover/retry under uncertainty while preserving honest historical meaning.
consequences: Effect-bearing adapters must define effect criteria stage transitions reconciliation capability cutover dispositions conformance and mandatory visibility for indeterminate work without becoming a general iPaaS/case-management platform.

title: Migration truth provenance and limitation
context: Migration can fabricate history assign current states directly collapse distinct actuals and duplicate commercial effects when legacy provenance is incomplete.
decision: Adopt explicit import/migration classes and immutable run/item manifests. No direct state balance or current-status assignment. Native open/full-history migration requires a versioned per-domain MigrationAcceptanceProfile defining supported source history minimum identity/time/evidence/authority/config target actions/effects cutover validation limitations and correction. Without a profile block native import or import as explicit reference/evidence-limited history. Never fabricate provenance merge weak identities collapse supplier source and normalized values collapse physical certified accounting-posted and paid actuals or use mutable current links as historical evidence.
alternatives: Generic ETL state loading; opening balances/statuses; best-effort history reconstruction; mandatory full migration before go-live.
reasons: Preserves authoritative meaning and honest limitations while allowing migration coverage to expand by domain through evidence-backed profiles.
consequences: Post-live remediation uses history-preserving domain/evidence correction. Physical ETL tooling and migration execution technology remain later choices.

title: Metric semantic authority and partial-population grammar
context: Reporting labels and formulas can become ambiguous shadow truth when source authority grain population denominator partiality time quality and access are not bound.
decision: Adopt one immutable versioned MetricDefinition grammar with closed metric classes authoritative source grain contribution population denominator time actual currency quality access correction and non-meaning. Every metric class and declared use binds exactly one PartialPopulationTreatment: BLOCK_ON_INCOMPLETE_POPULATION REPORT_EVALUABLE_SUBSET_WITH_EXPLICIT_SCOPE_DISCLOSURE or REPORT_DETERMINISTIC_RANGE. Returned accessible or evaluated rows never redefine the declared population. Calculations use an acyclic typed graph over a controlled operator-family registry; arbitrary SQL scripts user-defined functions tenant-authored operators runtime joins side effects and hidden manual adjustments are prohibited.
alternatives: Named KPIs with implementation-defined formulas; generic BI semantic layer; tenant-authored expressions; complete/partial flag only.
reasons: Prevents plausible understated totals hidden denominator drift generic formula-engine growth and reporting surfaces becoming business authority.
consequences: Subset and deterministic-range results have explicit value states and use ceilings. Unknown population extent cannot become a point subtotal. New metric/operator classes require prospective controlled architecture change.

title: Projection report snapshot restatement use and reliance
context: Live queries refreshes corrections semantic changes and later evidence or access changes can silently alter historical reports or grant perpetual reliance.
decision: Keep metric projection and report definitions executions results snapshots artifacts issues communications and restatements distinct. Issued snapshots are immutable exact member/source-cut artifacts. Recalculation creates new execution/result; semantic change source correction late fact identity or migration remediation implementation defect quality/materiality change and retrospective population change use explicit version/restatement lineage. Keep immutable issue-time use eligibility distinct from current SubsequentRelianceAssessment for new load-bearing use. Gap resolution requires restatement where impact exceeds the declared materiality basis. Forwarded copies cannot be recalled by promise and must carry or resolve issue/as-of/version/limitation/restatement-check context.
alternatives: Mutable report links; overwrite-on-refresh; one report identity across revisions; perpetual reliance after issue.
reasons: Preserves historical meaning and current safety without turning reporting into a records-management or notification platform.
consequences: P1.9 must distinguish issued current restated issue-time and current-reliance states. Physical snapshot storage renderer and status lookup remain later choices.

title: Time status actual and forecast reporting semantics
context: Generic current actual period and overdue labels collapse effective recorded known-at forecast physical commercial accounting and cash meanings.
decision: Adopt explicit source effective recorded observed known-at as-of execution publication and communication times; explicit point-position period-flow cohort rolling duration aging milestone and publication bases; and REQUIRED PLANNED FORECAST CONFIRMED ACTUAL SCENARIO TARGET families. Generic ACTUAL is invalid. Every actual binds PHYSICAL PRODUCT_COMMERCIAL_CERTIFIED EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTING_POSTED PAID_CASH or an exact communication technical or domain-transaction subtype. Unlike actual families may be compared but never summed substituted or selected by latest available. Recorded-period flow contains signed occurrences recorded in the period and is distinct from current position.
alternatives: One current timestamp; generic actual; latest available actual; overwrite forecast with actual.
reasons: Preserves historically reproducible and commercially honest reporting across product and external authority seams.
consequences: Later UI may simplify labels only while preserving exact family/time context. Portfolio aggregation requires like families and compatible cuts.

title: Result quality materiality and decision-use eligibility
context: A numerically correct result can still be unsafe because its population source freshness authority evidence migration reconciliation effect certainty access or comparability is limited.
decision: Adopt a complete non-overriding ResultQualityVector across thirteen dimensions and per-use USE_PERMITTED USE_PERMITTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS or USE_BLOCKED assessment. Every metric/use pairing binds a versioned MaterialityAndUsePolicy defining quantitative and qualitative materiality unknown/unbounded treatment and exact block-versus-limit behavior. ReportDecisionUseProfile and ReportUseAssessment prevent composition title layout or export from upgrading member use. Evaluated-subset results are blocked for commercial decision approval external issue and audit; deterministic ranges support higher use only through an exact conservative RangeConsumptionPolicy.
alternatives: Single quality score; worst-flag default; warning-only limitations; report title determines use.
reasons: Makes limitation and decision fitness deterministic while preventing confidence scores or presentation from laundering unsafe data.
consequences: P1.9 limitation rendering is load-bearing. Absence of a materiality policy blocks load-bearing use rather than creating implementation discretion.

title: Contribution comparability and partial-population aggregation
context: Aggregation can double count corrections hierarchy representations and currency forms or hide incomplete stale restricted conflicted and non-comparable members inside plausible portfolio totals.
decision: Adopt ContributionOccurrenceId EconomicContributionLineageKey ConservationGroupKey MetricContributionIdentity and versioned ContributionDispositionRule. Every metric declares additivity behavior. Every aggregate-capable metric/projection binds MetricAggregationQualityRule covering target population union/overlap evaluated and unevaluated members known and unknown gaps restricted treatment all quality-dimension composition partial treatment use consequences disclosure and gap-resolution restatement. Target-scope quality and use are recomputed not averaged or inherited. Incompatible actual source time currency population hierarchy evidence migration access and comparability are segmented normalized under explicit policy limited or blocked. Restricted members never redefine the denominator; cross-tenant aggregation benchmark reputation and learned influence remain OUT by default.
alternatives: Display-level dedupe; average quality/completeness; child-use inheritance; warehouse-owned totals; cross-tenant benchmarks.
reasons: Prevents double count and good-member-majority masking while retaining a no-warehouse no-second-writer architecture.
consequences: Ratios statistics and distinct counts are recomputed at target scope. Full restricted aggregates require disclosure and inference policy. P07 remains sole XL.
